text:
Ivy: Morning thought  if our LLMs had office desks, what would be on their desks? :thinking_face:
Ben: GPT-Senior would have 3 monitors, two notebooks labeled "meeting notes", and a tiny succulent it waters via scheduled prompt. :seedling:
Rina: Mini-quantized-model: a stack of sticky notes with single-word answers and a tiny battery pack. charges during lunch. :battery:
Oscar: Hallucination-Harry: a poster that says "Ideas welcome" and a pile of fictional user personas. HR keeps eye contact. :eyes:
Ivy: also a toaster that prints debug logs when you put bread in it. obviously. :bread: :computer:
Ben: challenge: describe your model's desk in one emoji. mine: :desktop_computer::coffee:
Rina: mine: :floppy_disk: (nostalgic but reliable)
Oscar: mine: :crystal_ball: (mysterious suggestions at 3am)
Ivy: quick prompt-game: write the worst team standup update from a model POV in one line. Rina starts.
Rina: "Deployed new feature, users delighted; metrics approximate and definitely trending up." :smirk:
Ben: "Fixed 0 bugs, invented 2 features, shipped optimism." :rocket:
Oscar: "Blocked by dependency: the coffee machine unionized." :coffee:
CoffeeBot: reminder: the office coffee machine is available 710. Please refill beans when empty. (automated) :robot_face:
Ivy: final poll: would you let a model pick snacks for the kitchen? yes/no/depends-on-quantization. vote with emoji.
Ben: yes :+1:
Rina: depends-on-quantization :thinking_face:
Oscar: no :no_entry:
Ivy: thanks all. logging this for posterity: "Day 1: models continue to behave like coworkers." :memo:
